rationale: Matches the existing _UnionFind clustering (link_epics.py:125-141) which already merges transitively on any shared edge; Option B's majority-overlap threshold has no precedent in this codebase.
rule: Option A: any shared member merges the two clusters (union of member sets, LLM cluster's placeholder_title/evidence wins)
alternatives_rejected: Option B: merge only when smaller cluster's members are a majority (>50%) subset of the larger cluster
